title: Farmworkers and Laborers, Crop, Nursery, and Greenhouse
description: Manually plant, cultivate, and harvest vegetables, fruits, nuts, horticultural specialties, and field crops. Use hand tools, such as shovels, trowels, hoes, tampers, pruning hooks, shears, and knives. Duties may include tilling soil and applying fertilizers; transplanting, weeding, thinning, or pruning crops; applying pesticides; or cleaning, grading, sorting, packing, and loading harvested products. May construct trellises, repair fences and farm buildings, or participate in irrigation activities.

tasks.text: Harvest plants, and transplant or pot and label them.
Identify plants, pests, and weeds to determine the selection and application of pesticides and fertilizers.
Participate in the inspection, grading, sorting, storage, and post-harvest treatment of crops.
Feel plants' leaves and note their coloring to detect the presence of insects or disease.
Inspect plants and bud ties to assess quality.
Sell and deliver plants and flowers to customers.
Record information about crops, such as pesticide use, yields, or costs.
Regulate greenhouse conditions, and indoor and outdoor irrigation systems.
Repair and maintain farm vehicles, implements, and mechanical equipment.
Harvest fruits and vegetables by hand.
Set up and operate irrigation equipment.
Maintain and repair irrigation and climate control systems.
Dig, cut, and transplant seedlings, cuttings, trees, and shrubs.
Operate tractors, tractor-drawn machinery, and self-propelled machinery to plow, harrow and fertilize soil, or to plant, cultivate, spray and harvest crops.
Record information about plants and plant growth.
Dig, rake, and screen soil, filling cold frames and hot beds in preparation for planting.
Load agricultural products into trucks, and drive trucks to market or storage facilities.
Move containerized shrubs, plants, and trees, using wheelbarrows or tractors.
Tie and bunch flowers, plants, shrubs, and trees, wrap their roots, and pack them into boxes to fill orders.
Clean work areas, and maintain grounds and landscaping.
Haul and spread topsoil, fertilizer, peat moss, and other materials to condition soil, using wheelbarrows or carts and shovels.
Repair farm buildings, fences, and other structures.
Plant, spray, weed, fertilize, water, and prune plants, shrubs, and trees, using gardening tools.
Direct and monitor the work of casual and seasonal help during planting and harvesting.
Provide information and advice to the public regarding the selection, purchase, and care of products.
Inform farmers or farm managers of crop progress.
Maintain inventory, ordering materials as required.

skills.name: Speaking
skills.def: Talking to others to convey information effectively.

skills.name: Operations Monitoring
skills.def: Watching gauges, dials, or other indicators to make sure a machine is working properly.

skills.name: Active Listening
skills.def: Giving full attention to what other people are saying, taking time to understand the points being made, asking questions as appropriate, and not interrupting at inappropriate times.

skills.name: Reading Comprehension
skills.def: Understanding written sentences and paragraphs in work-related documents.

skills.name: Writing
skills.def: Communicating effectively in writing as appropriate for the needs of the audience.

skills.name: Critical Thinking
skills.def: Using logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to problems.

skills.name: Monitoring
skills.def: Monitoring/Assessing performance of yourself, other individuals, or organizations to make improvements or take corrective action.

skills.name: Social Perceptiveness
skills.def: Being aware of others' reactions and understanding why they react as they do.

skills.name: Operation and Control
skills.def: Controlling operations of equipment or systems.

skills.name: Repairing
skills.def: Repairing machines or systems using the needed tools.

skills.name: Time Management
skills.def: Managing one's own time and the time of others.

skills.name: Active Learning
skills.def: Understanding the implications of new information for both current and future problem-solving and decision-making.

skills.name: Equipment Maintenance
skills.def: Performing routine maintenance on equipment and determining when and what kind of maintenance is needed.

skills.name: Troubleshooting
skills.def: Determining causes of operating errors and deciding what to do about it.

skills.name: Quality Control Analysis
skills.def: Conducting tests and inspections of products, services, or processes to evaluate quality or performance.

skills.name: Electronic mail software
skills.def: Software to compose, send, or receive email. Examples: IBM Lotus Notes, Microsoft Outlook.

skills.name: Spreadsheet software
skills.def: Software to create or edit numbers or text organized into rows and columns of cells. May include formulas which recalculate values based on other cells. Examples: Microsoft Excel.

skills.name: Office suite software
skills.def: Software to provide word processing, spreadsheet, e-mail, presentations, or data management capabilities. Examples: Microsoft Office software.

skills.name: Presentation software
skills.def: Software to create presentations, speeches, or slideshows. Examples: Microsoft PowerPoint.

skills.name: Word processing software
skills.def: Software to create, edit, store, or print documents. Examples: Microsoft Word.

skills.name: Data base user interface and query software
skills.def: Software to query, present, or edit information stored in a database sytem. Examples: BCL Landview Systems WinCrop, Farm Works Software Trac.
